browserResearch.scope: Synthetic fixtures on Chromium 159, Windows 11, two logical CPUs. Model-call latency excludes feature extraction and messaging.
browserResearch.readiness: Research prototype. Independent validation is incomplete and production deployment is NO-GO.
browserResearch.jobPeakScope: Whole neural browser test including Chromium and the harness, not model-only memory.

securityResearch.status: Offline research pilot. New warnings and blocking are disabled.
securityResearch.scope: Synthetic metadata classification only. No browser observations or operational accuracy were measured.
securityResearch.limitations: Cookie, navigation, download and content-setting APIs require additional permissions. No new permissions are requested by this pilot.
